narrative:
Columbiana County has 63,770 registered voters, with 18.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 26.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 50.0%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 23.1 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.7% of registrants.
